exposure: women with maternal complications vs women without maternal complications
women with neonatal complications vs women without neonatal complications
emergency caesarean delivery vs elective caesarean delivery
cohort: 544 women who underwent caesarean delivery in eastern Sudan
finding: Emergency caesarean delivery, maternal complications, and neonatal complications were associated with longer hospital stays after caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women with emergency CD stayed for 13.0% longer than women with elective CD (RR=1.13, 95% CI=1.01‒1.29).
